changelog: Editing stock grids now feels like a spreadsheet. Press Enter to move down the same column and Tab to move to the next cell, and editing continues smoothly in the next editable cell. Inline quantity edits in Stock Items save instantly with a confirmation banner and no longer cause the grid to jump or lag. The first click on a cell now selects cleanly without flicker, and dropdown cells (such as Brand in the Add Missing Master screen) open ready for typing. Right-click any grid to auto-fit or fit columns to the window. Batch stock deduction is more reliable on large runs.
